events.text:
I've finished the remaining launch prep for T-058 and handed the launch to Bhaskar. Nothing is launched and no prospect was messaged. T-058 stays blocked on the T-056 list import, and Bhaskar now owns the human steps.

What I found on the first line: Tantra's help centre says merge tags use double curly braces, like `{{firstName}}`. Single braces mean spintax (random choice of wording), so the old `{first_line}` would not have worked. Tantra's AI writing only covers email and calendar text, so each LinkedIn line has to come pre-written from T-059. The help centre doesn't say whether a custom field can be picked in a LinkedIn step. The kit covers that case: an empty field shows up as blank, so the step still reads fine without it.

| Item | State |
|---|---|
| 1. Run caps replace "PENDING Bharath's recorded values" | Done in an earlier run. I checked the file and no PENDING text is left. The caps read 20 to 25 connects/day, never above 75, 75 messages/day; the platform maximum stays 80/120/80. |
| 2. Settle how `{first_line}` gets into messages | Done. The kit's new section 3a says to add the T-059 line as a custom field called `firstLine` when the list is imported, then use `{{firstLine}}` in the LinkedIn step. It has to be in the first import, because re-importing a contact doesn't update its fields. |
| 3. Wave 1 fits the 2 existing slots, buy nothing | Done. New section 3b in the kit. The "+$20 each" line and the guide's "a slot gets added" line are gone. |
| 3. Ask Bharath about more slots at no charge | Done, as the T-058 task note. `pass.py` can't post a separate note and the inbox file must not be edited by hand. |
| 4. Bhaskar as assignee | Done. Owner, assignee and reviewer are all Bhaskar. The new section 5 and the connect guide now point members to Bhaskar. |
| Keep the T-056 blocker, drop T-057, no new ask for Adi | Done. The blockers are T-056 and members connecting. `needs_from_owner` names Bhaskar's steps only. |
| Publish to the board | Done: the evidence links are updated, and the board picks them up on its 5-minute sync. |
| Publish to the GitHub Pages mirror | Not done. The public mirror has never carried the outreach docs, and the referral dashboard didn't change, so there was nothing to republish. |
| Check | Referral tests passed 27 of 27 and `probe-referrals` passed 15 of 15. No em or en dashes in either file. `pass.py validate` passes. |
| Commit and acknowledge | Committed as `cfb7745c` (not pushed). Notes F-42394757 and R-2c951576 are acknowledged. |
| Not doable here | The three done_when items (profiles connected, campaign running, registrations on the dashboard) wait on the T-056 import and each member's own LinkedIn login. |
